## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are single-line [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) messages, and each builds.
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has a focused test with independently derived expected values.
- [ ] Critical logic has mutants in `tests/mutants.py`, all killed or documented as equivalent.
- [ ] No game files, disc images, executables, recompiled code (`ppc/`), traces or built binaries are included.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where the behaviour changed.
